cassette: The neighbour lent a working cassette player
The recording software initially appeared to capture one channel, with no named owner
The narrator noticed one insulating ring on the cable plug after an evening adjusting settings
A different cable restored both channels the next morning but a hum remained
The narrator kept the recording and made a separate copy for noise removal
observatory: Numbered cards are collected downstairs on the next two open evenings
A volunteer calls four numbers at a time after the previous group descends
Missed calls can join a later group and no names or telephone numbers are collected
After more than ten minutes of cloud the operator pauses calls and gives a speaker update
After the second evening volunteers compare longest waits against the previous open evening and note whether stairs stayed clear
mural: Map was behind a cupboard in the former harbour office
Map depicts the channel before the pier was extended
Workers stopped when a red line appeared and the archive was contacted that afternoon
The 1936 photograph shows a stove on the opposite wall and excludes the map area
Reported remarks remain indirect and no new quotations are attributed
kiln: The tiles used scraps from the same red clay as the bowls
The lower half was combed and the upper half left smooth
Number was scratched on the back before drying and recorded beside the recipe
The glaze on red clay stuck to the tray but on white clay had stopped short of the bottom edge
Different shelves confound the comparison and another pair is planned side by side

c-fiddle: Practice bow has a chip near the screw
Former pupil remembered the violin purchase but not the bow’s origin
Photo has a date and hall address but no photographer’s name
Apparent mark extends onto the jacket and might be a reflection
Enlargement retained and teacher not listed as previous owner
c-film: Display-case photography permission excludes projected film
Visitor recorded the title sequence on Saturday
Volunteer offered a catalogue still and screening continued without a break
Spoken reminder to be tried at three screenings before considering another sign
Talk-recording rules remain undecided and speakers may set conditions
c-gauge: Initially tank at third glass mark while side tube below its third mark
Slower refill did not fix the difference
Table sloped toward door and a thin board went under two front feet

Another table has not been tested; remaining scale contribution uncertain
c-grants: Grant covers larger print and extra library copy but not room hire
Buying a printer was suggested, with equipment eligibility unclear
Treasurer will check with grant organisation before ordering
Secretary seeks a comparison quote for three sets, without commitment
Email arrangements continue even for members requesting print

Roof letter present in May and absent in April; addition versus removal uncertain

f-jars: Plain lid label and numbered side label
